data.title: PDS Biotech Stock Surges Tuesday: What's Driving the Action?
data.description: Shares of PDS Biotechnology Corp (NASDAQ: PDSB) are trading sharply higher Tuesday afternoon, extending Monday's gains as investors continue to react to the closing of a multi-tranche financing agreement.

data.title: United States Oil Fund (USO) Hits 52-Week High as Supply Bottlenecks Intensify
data.description: Shares of the United States Oil Fund LP (NYSE: USO) surged to a new 52-week high Tuesday afternoon, tracking a sharp rally in benchmark crude futures as physical supply disruptions in the Middle East and tightening product markets heightened global supply concerns.
